surface: Foundation for the Octane Inertia 3.6.1 adapter: framework-neutral router, HTTP client, progress, and server exports reuse @inertiajs/core unchanged. Renderer-owned hooks and components are added in the dependent binding units.
divergences: React, ReactDOM, StrictMode, forwardRef, and synthetic events are not runtime dependencies; the Octane adapter uses Octane roots, refs-as-props, and native events.
ssr: The framework-neutral Inertia server entry is exposed. Octane page rendering and hydration are completed by the adapter SSR unit.
